limitations: This collection covers employer-facing Compliance circulars on returns and the ECR, KYC and Aadhaar seeding, UAN activation and the PAN-upload abolition. The internal ABP/MIS returns of field offices (2009-2017) are routine reporting and are not included, and returns of exempted establishments are in the Exemption collection.
Circulars whose only issuer title is in Hindi (for example the 2014-2015 ECR, digital-signature and Form 11 / KYC circulars) are not included in this collection.

The UAN activation and Aadhaar bank-seeding deadline of the 22 November 2024 circular was extended six times between December 2024 and June 2025; the links after 4 December 2024 are unverified because the circulars name earlier ones only as 'the circulars mentioned under references'. Whether any later circular extended it again is not recorded.

The 1 December 2025 circular discontinues the extension of the Aadhaar-seeding timeline for North East and certain establishments beyond 31 October 2025; it records the mandatory Aadhaar-seeded ECR requirement 'w.e.f. 01.06.2021', which is background and not a commencement of this circular.
The January 2026 due-date extensions are time-bound and apply to the wage month named in each circular; they do not change the standing due date.
Effective dates are recorded only where a circular names a wage month ('from wage month August 2025 onwards', 'wage month September 2025 onwards'); the first day of that month is used.

PDFs were read from the issuer mirror on 4 November 2026 because the public site returned 404 for these paths; recorded SHA-256 values apply to those files. Scanned pages are OCR. Issue dates were checked against the document headers.
